name: 实现 KeyManagementService (part 2)
description:
实现 KeyManagementService 服务方法: getKey, listKeys, validateKeyBinding
  - getKey: (id: UUID) -> SshKey pre=id对应的密钥在ssh_keys表中存在且deleted_at为NULL
  - listKeys: (page: int, pageSize: int) -> PageResult<SshKey> pre=page >= 1，pageSize >= 1 且 <= 100
  - validateKeyBinding: (keyId: UUID, environmentId: UUID) -> boolean pre=keyId对应的密钥存在且未删除；environmentId对应的环境在environments表中存在
